root_cause_verification.rationale: Root cause (commit 94bca5f) placed image fetching OUTSIDE the INNER loop, causing images to be fetched before user confirmation. This created a fetch-modify-refetch waste pattern when users requested changes. The fix correctly moves image fetching INSIDE the INNER loop as a substep of Option 1 ('This day is perfect') processing, ensuring images are fetched ONCE per confirmed day, AFTER user confirms perfect but BEFORE setting day_confirmed_perfect=true and exiting the loop. The new pattern is: present day → user confirms → fetch images → set flag → exit loop → next day. This completely eliminates the waste pattern by ensuring fetching only happens after final confirmation.
